q1.explanationZh: restaurant“餐馆”，注意结尾 -aurant 的拼写。

q2.explanationZh: rest“休息”加 -less“没有”，restless“得不到休息的；焦躁不安的”。

q3.explanationZh: restore“恢复；修复”，restore ... to its former glamour“恢复往日光彩”。

q4.explanationZh: restrict“限制”，be restricted to“被限制于……”。

q5.explanationZh: result 名词“结果”，动词“（作为结果）发生”，常用 result in / result from。

q6.explanationZh: résumé“简历”，带重音符号；不写重音符号的 resume 也接受，但 resume 还是动词“重新开始”。

q8.explanationZh: return 可作动词“返回；归还”，也可作名词“返回；回报”。

q9.explanationZh: 前缀 re-“再”加 unite“联合”，reunite“使重聚”。

q10.explanationZh: reveal“揭示；透露”，reveal a secret“透露秘密”。

q11.explanationZh: revenge 名词“复仇”，take revenge on sb.“向某人报仇”；也可作动词。

q12.explanationZh: reverse 形容词“反向的”，名词“相反情况”，the reverse“恰好相反”。

q13.explanationZh: re-“再”加 view“看”，review“复习；回顾”，也可作名词“评论”。

q15.explanationZh: revise 去 e 加 -ion 构成名词 revision“修改；复习”。

q17.explanationZh: revolution 加 -ary 构成形容词 revolutionary“革命的”。

q18.explanationZh: reward 名词、动词都是“报答；奖赏”，reward sb. with ... for sth.。

q19.explanationZh: 前缀 re-“再”加 write“写”，rewrite“重写；改写”。

q20.explanationZh: rhyme“韵”，注意 rh- 开头、中间是 y。

q21.explanationZh: rhythm“节奏”，拼写 rh-y-th-m，没有元音字母 a/e/i/o/u。

q22.explanationZh: rice“米饭”，一般作不可数名词。

q23.explanationZh: rich“富的；丰富的”，be rich in“富含……”。

q24.explanationZh: rid“使摆脱”，常用 get rid of“摆脱”。

q25.explanationZh: riddle“谜语”，solve the riddle“解开谜团”，注意双写 d。

q26.explanationZh: ride“骑；乘”，过去式 rode，过去分词 ridden。

q27.explanationZh: ride 加 -r 表示人，rider“骑手”。

q28.explanationZh: ridiculous“可笑的，荒谬的”，副词 ridiculously。

q29.explanationZh: right 形容词“对的；右边的”，名词“右边；权利”。

q30.explanationZh: rigid“僵化的；死板的”，rigid traditions“死板的传统”。

q31.explanationZh: ring 名词“戒指；环”，动词“按铃；打电话；（铃）响”，过去式 rang，过去分词 rung。

q33.explanationZh: rise 不及物动词“上升”，过去式 rose，过去分词 risen；名词“上涨”。

q34.explanationZh: “恢复”用 restore，“旧风俗”= an old custom。

q35.explanationZh: as a result“因此”，常单独放在句首，用逗号隔开。

q36.explanationZh: as a result of 后接名词，相当于 because of“由于”。

q37.explanationZh: result from 后接原因：结果 result from 原因。

q38.explanationZh: result in 后接结果：原因 result in 结果，与 result from 方向相反。

q39.explanationZh: revenge 作及物动词，revenge sth.“为某事报复”。

q40.explanationZh: revenge sb.“为（受害的）某人报仇”，如 revenge his dead brother。

q41.explanationZh: “向某人报复”用 be revenged on sb.，“因某事”用 for sth.。

q42.explanationZh: revenge oneself on sb.“向某人报复”，oneself 随主语变化。

q43.explanationZh: reward sb. with sth. for sth.：with 后接报答的东西，for 后接原因。

q44.explanationZh: “在某人的右边”= on one’s right，介词用 on。

accept: give sb. a ring/ring sb. up

q45.explanationZh: “给某人打电话”可说 give sb. a ring（名词），也可说 ring sb. up（动词）。

q46.explanationZh: get rid of“摆脱；除去”，rid 在这里是过去分词形式（与原形相同）。

q47.explanationZh: rise 作名词“上涨”，a rise in ...“……的上涨”。

q48.explanationZh: wedding“婚礼”作定语，a wedding ring“结婚戒指”。

q49.explanationZh: was 后需要形容词，restless“坐卧不宁的”，因疼痛而不安。

q50.explanationZh: “the + 比较级……，the + 比较级……”句型，better 修饰名词 result“结果；成绩”。

q51.explanationZh: the reverse“相反情况”，just the reverse“恰好相反”。

q52.explanationZh: has 后用过去分词构成现在完成时，return to“回到……”，returned。

q53.explanationZh: 秘密“被透露”，was not 后用过去分词 revealed 表被动；not ... till“直到……才”。

q54.explanationZh: would 后用动词原形，revenge sb.“为某人报仇”。

q55.explanationZh: in reward for“作为对……的奖赏”，这里填名词 reward。

q56.explanationZh: try to 后接动词原形，rewrite“改写”。

q57.explanationZh: its 后需要名词，指骑马的人，rider“骑手”。

q58.explanationZh: keep doing“持续做某事”，rise 去 e 加 -ing，rising“上涨”。

q59.sampleAnswer: I was so absorbed in reading that I didn’t hear my cell phone ringing.
references: I was so absorbed in reading that I didn’t hear my cell phone ringing.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “全神贯注于”= be absorbed in；“听到手机在响”= hear my cell phone ringing（hear sb./sth. doing）；so ... that 连接结果。

q60.sampleAnswer: His skill of restoring ancient paintings has reached such a level that he has restored the one covered with dust for a long time to its former glamour.
references: His skill of restoring ancient paintings has reached such a level that he has restored the one covered with dust for a long time to its former glamour.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “修复古画”= restore ancient paintings；“使……恢复往日光彩”= restore ... to its former glamour；such ... that“如此……以至于”。

q61.sampleAnswer: Our efforts are rewarded so long as the results of this research can be applied to the development of new technologies.
references: Our efforts are rewarded so long as the results of this research can be applied to the development of new technologies.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “努力得到回报”用被动 be rewarded；“只要”= so long as；“应用于”= be applied to。

q62.sampleAnswer: We look forward to your return from abroad.
references: We look forward to your return from abroad.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词 your return；“从国外回来”= return from abroad。

q63.sampleAnswer: Her wish to reunite with her parents came true.
references: Her wish to reunite with her parents came true.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “与……团聚”= reunite with；“愿望实现”= wish came true。

q64.sampleAnswer: It was his being too self-confident that resulted in the situation, because he didn’t fully understand the truth that if you listen to both sides, you will hear the truth.
references: It was his being too self-confident that resulted in the situation, because he didn’t fully understand the truth that if you listen to both sides, you will hear the truth.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “造成”= result in；“是……”用强调句 It was ... that ...；the truth that 引导同位语从句解释道理。

q65.sampleAnswer: The instability of the writer’s war-torn childhood cast a shadow over his work, giving rise to its dark theme.
references: The instability of the writer’s war-torn childhood cast a shadow over his work, giving rise to its dark theme.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “引起；导致”= give rise to，这里用现在分词 giving rise to 表结果；“投下阴影”= cast a shadow over。

q66.sampleAnswer: The phase of writing that is actually most important is revision.
references: The phase of writing that is actually most important is revision.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “修改”用名词 revision 作表语；“阶段”= phase。

q67.sampleAnswer: The southerners prefer rice and the northerners prefer food made from flour.
references: The southerners prefer rice and the northerners prefer food made from flour.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “喜欢”用 prefer；“米饭”= rice（不可数）；“面食”= food made from flour。

q68.sampleAnswer: You are supposed to get rid of carelessness, for it often leads to irretrievable errors.
references: You are supposed to get rid of carelessness, for it often leads to irretrievable errors.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “克服；摆脱”= get rid of；“应该”= be supposed to；“导致”= lead to。
